title: Joining a club
instructions: Max okulda bir kulübe katılmak istiyor. Kulüplerin günlerine ve saatlerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: max
script.text: Miss Taylor, I want to join a club after school.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Great! We have a chess club, a drama club and a football club.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: On Mondays and Wednesdays, from four to five.

script.speaker: max
script.text: Oh, I have piano lessons on Mondays. What about drama?

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Drama is on Thursdays, from half past three to five.

script.speaker: max
script.text: That's good. I'm free on Thursdays.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: OK. Your first lesson is next Thursday, in room twelve.

script.speaker: teacher
script.text: Just bring a bottle of water.

questions.prompt: Why can't Max join the football club?
options: He has piano lessons on Mondays.
questions.feedback: Pazartesi piyano dersi var; futbol pazartesi ve çarşamba.
questions.evidence: I have piano lessons on Mondays.

questions.feedback: Perşembe boş olduğu için drama kulübünü seçiyor.
questions.evidence: That's good. I'm free on Thursdays.

questions.prompt: What time does the drama club start?
questions.feedback: Drama üç buçukta başlıyor, beşte bitiyor.
questions.evidence: from half past three to five.

questions.prompt: What does Max need to bring?
questions.evidence: Just bring a bottle of water.
